


```{r}

library(haven)
library(dplyr)

# Helper function to read and combine years
make_bind <- function(year_start, year_end) {
  lapply(year_start:year_end, function(yr) {
    zip_path <- paste0("data/cepr_org_", yr, ".zip")
    tmp_dir  <- tempdir()
    unzip(zip_path, exdir = tmp_dir)
    dta_file <- file.path(tmp_dir, paste0("cepr_org_", yr, ".dta"))
    read_dta(dta_file) %>%
      mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
  }) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    type.convert(as.is = TRUE)
}

# 1983-1987
cpsr_bind4_8387 <- make_bind(1983, 1987)

# 1988-1992
cpsr_bind4_8892 <- make_bind(1988, 1992)

# 1993-1997
cpsr_bind4_9397 <- make_bind(1993, 1997)

# 1998-2002
cpsr_bind4_9802 <- make_bind(1998, 2002)

# 2003-2007
cpsr_bind4_0307 <- make_bind(2003, 2007)

# 2008-2012
cpsr_bind4_0812 <- make_bind(2008, 2012)

# 2013-2017
cpsr_bind4_1317 <- make_bind(2013, 2017)

```




```{r}

library(ggplot2)



# =============================================================================
# HELPER: takes a bind4 df, a state filter, an industry filter, a formula,
# a weight column, and returns avg_pct_diff
# state_filter:    "ca" | "nonca" | "all"
# ind_filter:      "construction" | "nonconstruction"
# ind_col:         "ind_2d" | "ind_nber"
# =============================================================================

calc_pct_premium <- function(df, state_filter, ind_filter, ind_col, formula_rhs, weight_col) {

  # State subset
  if (state_filter == "ca")    df <- subset(df, state == 93)
  if (state_filter == "nonca") df <- subset(df, state != 93)

  # Industry subset
  if (ind_filter == "construction")    df <- subset(df, df[[ind_col]] == 4)
  if (ind_filter == "nonconstruction") df <- subset(df, df[[ind_col]] != 4)

  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NA)

  df$race   <- as.factor(df$wbhao)
  df$county <- as.factor(df$fipscounty)

  fmla  <- as.formula(paste("wage3 ~", formula_rhs))
  model <- tryCatch(
    lm(fmla, data = df, weights = df[[weight_col]]),
    error = function(e) { message("lm error: ", e$message); return(NULL) }
  )
  if (is.null(model)) return(NA)

  uw          <- subset(df, union == 1)
  if (nrow(uw) < 10) return(NA)
  hours       <- mean(uw$uhourse, na.rm = TRUE)
  cf          <- uw
  cf$union    <- 0
  pred_cf     <- predict(model, newdata = cf)

  actual <- uw$wage3  * uw$uhourse 
  cfact  <- pred_cf   * uw$uhourse 

  mean((actual - cfact) / cfact * 100, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# =============================================================================
# Per-window settings: which ind col, which formula, which weight
#varies depending on data availability
# =============================================================================

window_meta <- list(
  "2013-2017" = list(df = "cpsr_bind4_1317", ind_col = "ind_2d",
                     rhs = "union + age + educ + race + female + married + forborn + year + county",
                     wt  = "lonwgt"),
  "2008-2012" = list(df = "cpsr_bind4_0812", ind_col = "ind_2d",
                     rhs = "union + age + educ + race + female + married + forborn + year + county",
                     wt  = "lonwgt"),
  "2003-2007" = list(df = "cpsr_bind4_0307", ind_col = "ind_2d",
                     rhs = "union + age + educ + race + female + married + forborn + year + county",
                     wt  = "lonwgt"),
  "1998-2002" = list(df = "cpsr_bind4_9802", ind_col = "ind_nber",
                     rhs = "union + age + educ + race + female + married + forborn + year + county",
                     wt  = "lonwgt"),
  "1993-1997" = list(df = "cpsr_bind4_9397", ind_col = "ind_nber",
                     rhs = "union + age + educ + race + female + married + forborn + year + county",
                     wt  = "lonwgt"),
  "1988-1992" = list(df = "cpsr_bind4_8892", ind_col = "ind_nber",
                     rhs = "union + age + educ + race + female + married + year",
                     wt  = "fnlwgt"),
  "1983-1987" = list(df = "cpsr_bind4_8387", ind_col = "ind_nber",
                     rhs = "union + age + educ + female + married + year",
                     wt  = "fnlwgt")
)

period_order <- names(window_meta)

# =============================================================================
# CLEAR MEMORY — keep only the cpsr_bind4_ objects and avg_pct_diff_ values
# =============================================================================

keep <- c(
  # bound datasets needed for the new calculations
  "cpsr_bind4_1317", "cpsr_bind4_0812", "cpsr_bind4_0307",
  "cpsr_bind4_9802", "cpsr_bind4_9397", "cpsr_bind4_8892", "cpsr_bind4_8387",
  # existing results needed for the CA construction plot
  "avg_pct_diff_1317", "avg_pct_diff_0812", "avg_pct_diff_0307",
  "avg_pct_diff_9802", "avg_pct_diff_9397", "avg_pct_diff_8892", "avg_pct_diff_8387",
  # the meta list and helper function defined above
  "window_meta", "calc_pct_premium", "period_order", "weeks_worked"
)

rm(list = setdiff(ls(), keep))
gc()

# =============================================================================
# LOOP — compute all four series for each window
# =============================================================================

results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(period_order, function(period) {
  meta <- window_meta[[period]]
  df   <- get(meta$df)   # fetch the already-loaded bind4 object by name

  ca_con    <- calc_pct_premium(df, "ca",    "construction",    meta$ind_col, meta$rhs, meta$wt)
  nonca_con <- calc_pct_premium(df, "nonca", "construction",    meta$ind_col, meta$rhs, meta$wt)
  ca_noncon <- calc_pct_premium(df, "ca",    "nonconstruction", meta$ind_col, meta$rhs, meta$wt)
  nonca_noncon <- calc_pct_premium(df, "nonca", "nonconstruction", meta$ind_col, meta$rhs, meta$wt)

  data.frame(
    period       = period,
    ca_con       = ca_con,
    nonca_con    = nonca_con,
    ca_noncon    = ca_noncon,
    nonca_noncon = nonca_noncon
  )
}))


# Reshape to long for ggplot
results_long <- reshape(results,
  varying   = c("ca_con", "nonca_con", "ca_noncon", "nonca_noncon"),
  v.names   = "pct_premium",
  timevar   = "series",
  times     = c("CA Construction", "Non-CA Construction",
                "CA Non-Construction", "Non-CA Non-Construction"),
  direction = "long"
)
results_long$period <- factor(results_long$period, levels = period_order)

results
```



```{r}
# =============================================================================
# THEME
# =============================================================================

theme_union <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, margin = margin(b = 6)),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey40", margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.caption     = element_text(size = 9,  color = "grey50"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "top",
    legend.title     = element_blank()
  )

series_colors <- c(
  "CA Construction"        = "#d62728",
  "Non-CA Construction"    = "#1f77b4",
  "CA Non-Construction"    = "#e07b39",
  "Non-CA Non-Construction"= "#2ca02c"
)

# =============================================================================
# PLOT 1 — CA Construction premium over time (standalone)
# =============================================================================

p1 <- ggplot(subset(results_long, series == "CA Construction"),
             aes(x = period, y = pct_premium, group = 1)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#d62728", width = 0.7) +
  geom_line(color = "#7f0000", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(color = "#7f0000", size = 2.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(x, 1), "%")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Union Weekly Wage Premium – CA Construction Workers",
    subtitle = "Percent premium, union vs. comparable non-union (5-year windows)",
    x = NULL, y = "Premium (%)",
    caption  = "Source: CEPR ORG. Controls vary by period to match available variables."
  ) +
  theme_union

p1

```



```{r}
# =============================================================================
# PLOT 2 — CA Construction vs Non-CA Construction
# =============================================================================

p2 <- ggplot(subset(results_long, series %in% c("CA Construction", "Non-CA Construction")),
             aes(x = period, y = pct_premium, color = series, group = series)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = series_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(x, 1), "%")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Construction Union Weekly Wage Premium: California vs. Rest of Country",
    subtitle = "Percent premium (5-year windows)",
    x = NULL, y = "Premium (%)",
    caption  = "Source: CEPR ORG."
  ) +
  theme_union

# =============================================================================
# PLOT 3 — Non-construction industries: CA vs Non-CA
# =============================================================================

p3 <- ggplot(subset(results_long, series %in% c("CA Non-Construction", "Non-CA Non-Construction")),
             aes(x = period, y = pct_premium, color = series, group = series)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = series_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(x, 1), "%")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Union Weekly Wage Premium – All Industries Except Construction",
    subtitle = "California vs. Rest of Country (5-year windows)",
    x = NULL, y = "Premium (%)",
    caption  = "Source: CEPR ORG."
  ) +
  theme_union

# =============================================================================
# PLOT 4 — All four series together
# =============================================================================
results_long$period <- factor(results_long$period, levels = rev(period_order))
p4 <- ggplot(results_long,
             aes(x = period, y = pct_premium, color = series, group = series)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = series_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(x, 1), "%")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Union Weekly Wage Premium by Sector and Region",
    subtitle = "Percent premium (5-year windows)",
    x = NULL, y = "Premium (%)",
    caption  = "Source: CEPR ORG."
  ) +
  theme_union +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 7)
  )
```
